mwah.sense: intj: The sound of a kiss, to indicate blowing a kiss to someone.
mwah.hook: Wiktionary gives no earlier form for this sense.

firstUse.quote: 'Cause he looks like how Bayboy draws Sam the dog / With the beard I can sink my lips into like mwah
firstUse.source: 2025, Fraxiom, “kutna hora”, performed by Food House:

mwalimu.sense: noun: A teacher in parts of Africa.

firstUse.quote: Drawing on their African heritage, many Comorians also consult mwalimus or fundi (medicine men and astrologers learned in the use of sacred texts and knowledge) and marabouts (holy men) for divination
firstUse.source: 2006, Thomas Riggs, Worldmark Encyclopedia of Religious Practices: Countries A-L:

mwenge.sense: noun: An alcoholic drink of Uganda, made with fermented bananas…

mwami.sense: noun: A traditional king or ruler in various African nations.

mwabvi.hook: Wiktionary gives no earlier form for this sense.
